participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Cheerful and imaginative, loves adventure and fairy tales.
participant_1.background: I love to sing songs from the movie Frozen. I love to go to Disney World every year. I play with my friends on the playground. I'm in the third grade. Mickey Mouse is my favorite character.

participant_2.name: George
participant_2.personality: Wise and jovial, enjoys reminiscing and sharing stories.
participant_2.background: I am 100 years old. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. I remember when nobody had a television. I feel like I might live forever. I'm very strong for my age.
